ingress.responsibility: bounded public routing, request-size/rate boundary, and transport metadata
ingress.why_selected: async submit/status/result routes need a managed HTTP boundary; Lambda Function URL provides a weaker public abuse-control surface and REST API adds capabilities not yet justified

api_handler.responsibility: deterministic request admission, idempotency, job/status/result API projection, and queue submission
api_handler.why_selected: the public control path is short and deterministic and does not contain the measured 17.748-second analysis workload

job_queue.responsibility: durable at-least-once job buffering, retry isolation, and backpressure
job_queue.why_selected: Gate 19.2 selected async specifically for retry safety, provider-latency isolation, and backpressure

dead_letter_queue.responsibility: bounded quarantine for poison or repeatedly failing deliveries
dead_letter_queue.why_selected: terminal handling must not depend on unbounded redelivery

worker.responsibility: execute exactly one admitted public-analysis job attempt and persist deterministic terminal evidence
worker.why_selected: the measured representative workload completed in 17.748 seconds and does not justify container-orchestrated compute

job_store.responsibility: job identity, idempotency binding, conditional state transitions, admitted result persistence, and expiry metadata
job_store.why_selected: the measured admitted result is 5,285 bytes and requires conditional state/idempotency semantics rather than blob-scale storage

candidate_topologies.reason: directly satisfies async buffering, backpressure, retry isolation, deterministic state transitions, bounded result persistence, and short-lived worker compute
fewer resource types but weaker queue-specific retry/backpressure/dead-letter semantics and couples job dispatch to persistence stream behavior
durable orchestration is credible but adds workflow semantics and retention behavior not justified by the current single linear analysis job
reduces ingress components but weakens the explicit managed public routing and abuse-control boundary required for productization
container worker capacity is not justified by the measured 17.748-second workload and would increase operational surface

iam_responsibility_contract.resource_scope: selected job queue and selected jobs table only
selected job queue, selected jobs table, retained Knowledge Base BTVJ2PBR2A, and retained model/inference profile us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 only
explicitly_forbidden: sqs:SendMessage from public request handling authority

next_boundary: implement the selected topology in Terraform and application adapters behind disabled/non-public defaults, then require exact plan and least-privilege review before any public deployment
